User.title: User Profile
User.description: Represents a developer's assessment history, bookmarks, achievements, name, and daily streak metrics.

userName.description: The custom nickname or name of the developer.

streak.description: Number of consecutive days active on the platform.

lastActive.description: The last day the developer was active.

completedAssessments.description: List of historical assessment scorecard records.

achievements.description: List of unlocked platform achievement badges.

/users/{userId}.description: Saves full developer progress and quiz scoring historical details.
